front.title: Post-Quantum Key Provisioning and Lifecycle Operations for IoT Deployments Using WireGuard

abstract.t:
This document discusses post-quantum key provisioning and lifecycle operations for Internet of Things (IoT) deployments that already use WireGuard, such as fleets of industrial gateways and capable managed devices with little or no local user interface. It addresses authorized tunnel onboarding, identity-to-key binding, preshared-key rotation, installation-state reconciliation, failure remediation, quarantine, and decommissioning at a scale that makes manual maintenance impractical.
The operational model assumes independently provisioned trust and authorized management that remains reachable when the target tunnel fails. It relates provisioning to inventory, separate access policy, observable readiness, and device lifecycle decisions. It uses the existing WireGuard PresharedKey configuration interface and leaves the native handshake and transport format unchanged. WireGuard remains an externally maintained dependency.
An appendix retains a candidate ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA bootstrap exchange for technical discussion and further security and interoperability review. This individual contribution seeks Informational publication of the operational discussion and feedback on the appropriate venue for any new protocol work.
